beats.title: A Knife in the Dark, Foiled

beats.statement: The court of the Mad King assembles to open the show.
The Mad King decrees that the Friday bottle and the throne go to the last contestant standing. The court proclaims it.
Matti secretly pays the Faceless assassins to kill Sanna. The contract is not carried out yet.
A seer speaks a prophecy about who will win the throne, and Åsa hears it.
Pekka poisons a goblet and serves it to Aino. Aino drinks it and dies. This is the first blood of the contest.
A Faceless assassin hired by Matti carries out the contract and kills Sanna.

announcements.headline: Sanna is OUT
announcements.cause: slain by a Faceless assassin hired by Matti

beats.statement: Ville and Liisa lead their houses into battle on a muddy field. Heli and Pekka are killed. Åsa escapes.

announcements.headline: Heli is OUT
announcements.cause: killed in the Battle of the Muddy Field

announcements.headline: Pekka is OUT
announcements.cause: killed in the Battle of the Muddy Field

announcements.headline: 2 are OUT
announcements.cause: in the Battle of the Muddy Field

beats.statement: Åsa renounces the crown, takes the Grey Cloak and leaves the contest for the Wall.

announcements.headline: Åsa is OUT
announcements.cause: forfeited by taking the Grey Cloak

beats.statement: The Mad King sees Öhman as a threat to the throne and banishes them from the realm.
Ville meets Kalle in a trial by combat and wins. Kalle is killed.

announcements.headline: Kalle is OUT
announcements.cause: slain by Ville in Trial by Combat

beats.statement: The Iron Vault calls in Ulla's debt. Ulla cannot pay and is exiled from the realm.

announcements.headline: Ulla is OUT
announcements.cause: exiled by the Iron Vault for an unpaid debt

beats.statement: Timo meets Jääskeläinen in a trial by combat and wins. Jääskeläinen is killed.

announcements.headline: Jääskeläinen is OUT
announcements.cause: slain by Timo in Trial by Combat

beats.statement: The kingsmoot votes to exile Iiro, Liisa and Timo from the realm. Eero escapes.
The Red Priestess brings Aino back from the dead. Aino is alive again and back in the contest.

announcements.headline: Aino RETURNS
announcements.cause: raised from the dead by the Red Priestess and back in the contest

beats.statement: The Iron Vault calls in Ville's debt. Ville cannot pay and is exiled from the realm.

announcements.headline: Ville is OUT
announcements.cause: exiled by the Iron Vault for an unpaid debt

beats.statement: Eero narrowly escapes a deadly accident and stays in the contest.
The Mad King sees Aino as a threat to the throne and banishes them from the realm.
Eero and Matti swear an alliance to stand together.
Matti tries to stab their ally Eero in the back, but fails. Eero survives, and the alliance between them is broken.
Eero and Matti, the last two contestants, fight the final duel. Matti is killed.

announcements.headline: Matti is OUT
announcements.cause: defeated by Eero in the Last Duel

beats.statement: Eero is crowned the new monarch of the Bottle Throne by the Mad King.

thread_seeds.title: The Faceless contract on Sanna
thread_seeds.summary: Matti pays the Faceless to kill Sanna; the contract hangs over them.

thread_seeds.title: Aino cheats death
thread_seeds.summary: Aino falls, is raised by the Red Priestess, and must live with the price.

thread_seeds.title: Eero is spared, for now
thread_seeds.summary: Eero escapes once, and the story comes back for them.

thread_seeds.title: The alliance of Eero and Matti
thread_seeds.summary: Eero and Matti swear to stand together, and must face what that costs.

thread_seeds.title: Matti turns on Eero
thread_seeds.summary: After the failed knife, Eero knows Matti cannot be trusted.

thread_seeds.title: The prophecy
thread_seeds.summary: The seer's riddle is spoken early and fulfilled at the coronation.

thread_seeds.title: Eero's road
thread_seeds.summary: Eero keeps finding a way through.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Hear ye! The bottle awaits a worthy hand.

lines.speaker: old_king
lines.text: I am the Mad King, and this throne is still warm.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Let the peasants step forward!

lines.speaker: old_king
lines.text: New rules: no sulking, no mercy, no refunds.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nobody dares to ask what the old rules were.

lines.speaker: p15
lines.text: I would have done it with more style.

lines.speaker: p08
lines.text: One name. One coin. No questions.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The name on the parchment reads: Sanna.

lines.speaker: p01
lines.text: Interesting. Very, very interesting.

lines.speaker: p02
lines.text: Interesting. Very, very interesting.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Hear the prophecy, little ones!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One who was betrayed by a sworn ally...

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: One who bears the sign of the Wolf...

lines.speaker: p14
lines.text: That could be anyone!

lines.speaker: p01
lines.text: Strange vintage...

lines.speaker: p09
lines.text: Very rare. Very final.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Aino falls, and is out of the contest.

lines.speaker: p08
lines.text: Money well spent.

lines.speaker: p10
lines.text: Who is standing behind me?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Sanna falls, and is out of the contest.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Two banners, one very muddy field.

lines.speaker: p13
lines.text: Hold the line!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Heli and Pekka fall in the muck.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The ghost of Aino has come to watch.

lines.speaker: p01
lines.text: Now we are even.

lines.speaker: p06
lines.text: And this is why I never sit near the door.

lines.speaker: p14
lines.text: I renounce the crown. The Wall needs me.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Åsa walks north, wrapped in grey.

lines.speaker: old_king
lines.text: Öhman, you are banished. Today.

lines.speaker: p15
lines.text: You cannot do this!

lines.speaker: old_king
lines.text: Crown says I can.

lines.speaker: p12
lines.text: And this is why I never sit near the door.

lines.speaker: p06
lines.text: Have at thee!

lines.speaker: p13
lines.text: Have at thee harder!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Kalle falls, and is out of the contest.

lines.speaker: p05
lines.text: I saw nothing. I will remember everything.

lines.speaker: p12
lines.text: I only borrowed a little crown money.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Vault exiles Ulla with interest.

lines.speaker: p11
lines.text: Let the gods decide, Jääskeläinen!

lines.speaker: p05
lines.text: The gods owe me money.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The gods do not pay. Jääskeläinen goes down.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Stones are counted. Feelings are hurt.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Iiro, Liisa and 1 more must leave the realm.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Flames rise. The Red Priestess whispers old words.

lines.speaker: p01
lines.text: I... was dead? Did I miss lunch?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The Iron Vault sends its regards, and its bill.

lines.speaker: p13
lines.text: Can I pay in compliments?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Ville is escorted to the harbor. One way.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A falling gargoyle misses Eero by a hair.

lines.speaker: p02
lines.text: I meant to do that!

lines.speaker: old_king
lines.text: Aino, you are banished. Today.

lines.speaker: p01
lines.text: You cannot do this!

lines.speaker: old_king
lines.text: Crown says I can.

lines.speaker: p02
lines.text: Together we rise, Matti.

lines.speaker: p08
lines.text: Together. Until it is inconvenient.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: They shake on it. Both count their fingers after.

lines.speaker: p02
lines.text: I saw that coming, Matti.

lines.speaker: p08
lines.text: Saw what? I was... sharpening a spoon.

lines.speaker: p08
lines.text: Only one of us leaves this place, Eero.

lines.speaker: p02
lines.text: Then I will hold the door for you.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Steel rings. The rival's rod snaps. It is over.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Matti falls, and is out of the contest.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And so the prophecy is fulfilled.

lines.speaker: p02
lines.text: The bottle is mine!

lines.speaker: old_king
lines.text: Take good care of it.

chronicle.epilogue: When the dust settled, Eero the Zealot sat upon the Bottle Throne. 15 rivals fell, fled or were sent away along the way. The old crown passed on, the prophecy came true, and the bottle was finally opened. Long may Eero reign, at least until next Friday.

chronicle.blurb: 15 peasants. One bottle. Alliances, betrayals and a very suspicious goat. Who will be crowned when the curtain falls?
